thread:
mike.sales: Quick Q for security & SE — AcmeCorp wants a SOC2 snapshot + signed pen-test letter for our POC. They also asked if we can provide ephemeral KMS keys for staging so their auditors can run an external scan. Any blockers?
anya.se: short answer: we can support ephemeral creds for the POC, but need to confirm network egress + presigned upload flow.
lucas.sec: @anya.se correct. Two things: (1) our pen-test attestation template needs the customer's signatory info filled (we can send a draft), (2) ephemeral KMS in Private requires a short runbook and an HSM/KMS owner to approve.
mike.sales: timeline is tight — customer wants evidence by EOW. Can we get the draft pen-test letter + pointer to the SOC2 artifact bundle by Friday?
dena.pm: I'll pull the SOC2 snapshot (redacted) and create a minimal artifacts zip. Lucas — can security approve a redaction pattern for internal IPs?
lucas.sec: yes, we use the standard redaction: {internal_ips, amber-hostnames}. I'll attach the template and the example redaction checklist. Audit-bot: SOC2 snapshot generated (redacted) — link: https://files.redwood.example/soc2/acmepoc-2026-03-20.zip
anya.se: for ephemeral KMS we need two things from the customer: (a) list of staging CIDR ranges for the on-prem firewall, (b) preferred KMS key rotation window. Also note Dedicated pricing bump for single-tenant KMS — I'll add cost numbers.
mike.sales: customer already shared CIDRs. I'll DM them for rotation window. Can you add the Dedicated delta to the quote?
anya.se: adding a line item — Dedicated+KMS isolation -> +$3,500/month (est). Will confirm exact after infra signoff.
lucas.sec: also need pen-test signatory name + corporate contact for letter. If they want an independent red-team confirmation, that extends timeline by ~2 wks.
dena.pm: I'm assembling the evidence bundle. Draft checklist I'm using: 1) SOC2 redacted report 2) Network diagram 3) Pen-test letter draft 4) KMS keyflow diagram 5) Presigned upload instructions 6) Staging creds (ephemeral) runbook
mike.sales: can you drop the presigned upload snippet here so I can show devs?
anya.se: sure — presigned example: 
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-proofpack/acme-poc.zip --expires-in 3600
```
lucas.sec: NOTE: use short expiry (<=1h) and single-use tracking. We add a log entry with the request id.
mike.sales: perfect. I'll bundle everything and send to Acme. One more ask — customer asked if pen-test letter can state we support on-prem deployments with HSM. Is that safe to include?
lucas.sec: include a line that says "Redwood supports Private deployments with customer-managed KMS/HSM integrations" — we can't assert specific vendor integrations unless validated.
dena.pm: I'll attach the SOC2 excerpt + the redaction checklist and the pen-test draft to a shared folder and ping legal for a quick sign-off.
audit-bot: Pen-test-attestation-template_v1.docx uploaded to https://files.redwood.example/templates/pen-test-attestation_v1.docx
mike.sales: thanks everyone — I'll update the customer and ask for signer details. If anything slips, will loop back here. :thumbsup:
